name: ⚡Sprinting Simulator
desc:
Welcome to ⚡ Sprinting Simulator, the ultimate destination for speed enthusiasts!  🏃‍♂️ Dash through exhilarating obstacle courses, ⏰ race against the clock, and ☢️beware of dangers to claim the title of the 🏆 Fastest Sprinter!  Compete on 🏁 5+ race tracks, ⚡ unlock Epic Trails, and collect and trade the best 🐾 Mega Pets to dominate the leaderboard! Whether you're a seasoned sprinter or a newcomer to the track, get ready to break records and experience the thrill of speed like never before!

🤑 Value List - Each Pet has its own unique 💎 Gem Value that is determined by the players through 🗳️ voting!

✉️For each friend you play with in-game, you receive a Win Boost! (Up to 5 Friends)
